primary_baseline.trainable_adapter: Standard LoRA on Attention (q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj), r=8, alpha=16
primary_baseline.temporal_injection: Eq. 5 direct addition to year token embeddings (h' = h + TE(x) + TE(y))
primary_baseline.training_data: TempUN Small train_nwp.jsonl (2,461 samples) across year:1947 -> year:1984 -> year:2022

primary_competitor.trainable_adapter: Periodic Dual-Cycle MaT-LoRA on 72 MLP modules, r=8, alpha=16, K=2
primary_competitor.temporal_injection: Gated Residual Seam at token index 14 prefill (alpha_0=0.0)
primary_competitor.training_data: TempUN Small train_nwp.jsonl (2,461 samples) across year:1947 -> year:1984 -> year:2022

evaluation_protocol.free_vocabulary_requirement: Strictly no option scoring, no logit filtering/masking, no grammar constraints.
evaluation_protocol.task_conditioned_validity: MCQA accepts only [a-d]; Yes/No accepts only [Yes, No]. Mismatches marked INVALID_WRONG_TYPE.
evaluation_protocol.nature_of_180_cases: Exploratory / Hypothesis-generating (since n=24 was inspected during prompt engineering).

comparison_nature: WHOLE_METHOD_COMPARISON (Differences span temporal representation, injection point, adapter modules, and loss function; does not isolate individual components).
